## Numbered actions

1. Reconfirm the rail and cartridge are flush before touching any fastener.
2. Start PT-HOLD-R1 and PT-HOLD-R2 with washers by hand through the rail and station.
3. Tighten PT-HOLD-TCP, R1, and R2 incrementally to 0.25-0.35 N m while watching for rail lift.
4. Drop the two measured M4 clamp nuts from the top into their selected channels and verify the horizontal screw axes remain clear.
5. Install both M3 TCP screws evenly; stop as soon as the cartridge is retained and remains flush.
6. Recheck rail seating, cartridge height, cable-saddle access, and all three board-retainer stacks.

## STOP

> Stop if a shared M4 stack lifts the rail, a clamp nut spins or cracks its tower, or an M3 screw changes cartridge height or flushness.
